Priya S: Morning all-hands check-in — quick round.
Priya S: What I did yesterday: merged the config migration for routing policies, ran the staging perf tests (50k reqs/min) and fixed an autoscaler flapping issue.
Priya S: Blockers: seeing an intermittent KV cache invalidation when sequence lengths spike; reproducing locally is flaky.
Priya S: Today: follow up with eng-runtime on KV cache telemetry, and roll the canary for the config migration to 10%.

Alex G: Nice! For the KV cache issue — I added a verbose trace flag to the runtime yesterday, can flip it on in staging.
Alex G: @Jamal K can you watch the canary rollout this morning? :eyes:

Jamal K: On it — I'll monitor traces and traceroute the cache hits. Will ping if I see >1% miss rate.

Maria L: FYI I have a CR up for the batching timeout tweak: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serving/pull/412
Maria L: Would appreciate a quick review, should be small (2 files). @Alex G @Taylor R

Taylor R: I'll take a look after standup. If it's safe, we can include it in the same canary window.

Priya S: ops-bot: schedule canary rollout 10% for config-migration-2025
ops-bot: Scheduled: canary config-migration-2025 -> 10% at 2025-08-15T09:30Z (job id c-mig-2025-09)

Alex G: Small logistics: product asked if we can extend SLA window for Dedicated smoke tests by +15m to reduce flakiness — ok from infra side?
Taylor R: Fine by me, update the job timeout in the CI template (i'll open a tiny PR).

Maria L: Blocker for me: need a dev token that has embeddings quota for a partner demo. @Priya S can you grant or point me to requester flow?
Priya S: Will add you to the demo-embed role today.

Jamal K: Quick note — I'll be OOO tomorrow afternoon for training, leaving watch handoff to Alex.
Alex G: Got it, will handle paging.

Priya S: Thanks team — main asks: (1) review Maria's CR, (2) monitor canary and report any >1% KV miss, (3) Alex/Taylor to update CI timeout PR.
Priya S: Quick emoji check: react with :white_check_mark: when you read and can handle your item.

Taylor R: ✅
Alex G: ✅
Maria L: ✅
Jamal K: ✅ (will DM if anything spikes)

Priya S: Closing the thread — will post a short canary status update in ~45m.
